advisory_findings.claim: The closure proposal treats retention as an outstanding human decision and offers raw-output retention as an alternative, while the PRD and policy confirm minimal receipts and prohibit persisting raw output. This leaves contradictory acceptance criteria: a reviewer following this proposal could reopen an already confirmed decision or approve retention that violates SUP-014. Update the proposal to reflect the confirmed policy and remaining gates.

The document checker reads a fixed absolute checkout directory. Running it from another checkout either fails before checking anything or checks unrelated files if that directory exists. Resolve the document directory relative to __file__ so the reported checks describe the candidate being reviewed.

The five checker scenarios assert only that their outputs are admitted by the contract, without asserting the expected return code, verdict, event, or observation for each scenario. A checker that returns the same valid infrastructure-failure envelope for every input could pass all five positive cases. Add scenario-specific assertions on externally observable output so synthetic success, contradiction, invalid input, read failure, and partial scanning are actually distinguished.
